items.label: Convenient Charging Station
items.value: The entryway table is equipped with 3 power outlets and 2 USB charging ports, making it easy and convenient to charge your smartphone, gaming device, or other devices. You can charge your devices as soon as you get home without having to look around for a power source. The sockets can be installed on the left or right side as required.

items.label: Humanized Light Design
items.value: This wood console table applies an intelligent human body sensing system, the light will automatically turn on and off when you approach or leave, and it is very simple to use. Arrive to a welcoming glow at night – our smart lights sense you & turn on automatically, make you feel a warm light, and no more looking for the switch of light in the dark.

items.label: Sturdy Material and Solid Construction
items.value: The hallway table is built with an extra-thick MDF board top and designed to withstand daily wear and tear. Its appealing wood-like finish contributes to an authentic aesthetic, enhancing its rustic appeal. The stable construction can prevent the entrance table from wobbling, and the bottom of the entry table is equipped with thoughtful footpads to prevent the table from scratching the carpet.

items.label: Simple and Versatile Design
items.value: The farmhouse entryway table's simple, timeless look effortlessly shifts roles. Whether used as a stylish foyer table in the entryway, a functional sofa table behind the couch in the living room, or a graceful accent table in a hallway or dining area, the console table proves its adaptability across different home areas.

items.label: Easy to Assemble
items.value: The entryway table comes with detailed instructions, labeled parts, and included hardware, making assembly a cinch. Note: We provide two installation videos. If you meet any issue with our entry way table in quality or assembly, please feel free to contact us, and we will respond to you within 24 hours.NOTE: Due to variances in lighting and screen settings, the actual color of the console table may differ slightly from the color shown in the picture.
